designators.label: Cancel
designators.description: Cancel designated building, mining, hauling, harvesting, and all other designations.

designators.label: Deconstruct
designators.description: Deconstruct this and reclaim part of its resources.

designators.label: Mine
designators.description: Designate areas of rock to be mined out.

designators.label: Chop wood
designators.description: Marks trees to be chopped down for wood.

designators.label: Cut plants
designators.description: Marks plants to be cut and destroyed. The plant will be completely removed, and any food or resource yield will be harvested.

designators.label: Harvest
designators.description: Marks plants to be harvested for their food or other products.

designators.label: Hunt
designators.description:
Mark animals to be hunted by your hunters.

Only hunters with suitable ranged weapons will hunt.

designators.label: Slaughter
designators.description: Slaughter a tame animal.

designators.label: Tame
designators.description: Tame a wild animal.

designators.label: Haul things
designators.description: Mark rock chunks and other items to be hauled to dumping areas. Not needed for things like food or corpses, which are always haulable.

designators.label: Claim
designators.description: Claim neutral structures for the colony, including ancient ruins and abandoned siege bases. Claimed structures can be repaired and maintained by your colonists.

designators.label: Allow selection
designators.description:
Unforbid all items in the selected area.
Click and drag over an area to use.

designators.label: Forbid selection
designators.description:
Forbid all items in the selected area.
Click and drag over an area to use.

designators.label: Chop all wood
designators.description: Marks trees to be chopped down for wood regardless of growth level.

designators.label: Harvest all
designators.description: Marks harvestable plants to be harvested regardless of growth level.

designators.label: Chop grown wood
designators.description: Marks fully grown trees to be chopped down for wood.

designators.label: Harvest grown
designators.description: Marks fully grown plants to be harvested for their food or other products.

designators.label: Cut blighted
designators.description: Cut only blighted plants

designators.label: Cut grown
designators.description: Marks fully grown plants to be cut and destroyed. The plant will be completely removed, and any food or resource yield will be harvested.

designators.label: Strip Mine
designators.description: Mine a grid rather than everything

designators.label: Finish off
designators.description: Toggle finishing off

designators.label: Select similar
designators.description: Selects items similar to those already selected

designators.label: Haul urgently
designators.description: Mark rock chunks and other items to be hauled to dumping areas. Not needed for things like food or corpses, which are always haulable.

designators.label: Allow everything
designators.description: Unforbids all forbidden items on the map. Click to activate. Hold Ctrl/Option to include buildings. Hold Shift to include skeletons and non-fresh corpses.

designators.label: Select similar
designators.description: Selects only things similar to those already selected. Hold Shift to pick additional things. Hold Alt to ignore selection limits.

designators.label: Haul urgently
designators.description: Mark things to be hauled as soon as possible. Colonists will delay other work until hauling is complete. Configurable in the Work tab. Hold Shift to interrupt current colonist work.

designators.label: Finish off
designators.description: Quickly and painlessly kill downed creatures. Hold Shift to include colonists and allies. Requires a colonist with a melee skill of 6 or higher to use.

designators.label: Harvest fully grown
designators.description: Orders the harvesting or chopping crops and trees that are sufficiently grown to yield their maximum amount of resources when gathered. Hold Shift to include only plants. Hold Ctrl/Option to include only trees.

designators.label: Strip mine
designators.description: Lays out mine orders in a grid to maximize the chance to find hidden ores. Hold Shift to show settings window or designate using current settings.

designators.label: Smooth surface
designators.description: Designate rough stone terrain and walls to be smoothed.

designators.label: Paint building...
designators.description: Designate walls and buildings to be painted using dye from tinctoria plants, which you can grow. Only certain buildings can be painted.

designators.label: Paint floor...
designators.description: Designate floors to be painted using dye from tinctoria plants, which you can grow. Only certain floors can be painted.

designators.label: Remove paint
designators.description: Remove paint from walls, buildings, and floors.

designators.label: Plan
designators.description:
Place planning designations. These don't do anything except help you plan future expansions.

Right-click to hide or unhide all planning zones.

designators.label: Remove plans
designators.description: Remove planning designations.

designators.label: Export
designators.description: Export a building to xml

designators.label: Export from area
designators.description: Export a building to xml from area

designators.label: Destroy item
designators.description: Burns chosen item at closest campfire, destroying it completely. Requires campfire or smelter to work.

designators.label: Designator route
designators.description: Designator route desc

designators.label: constructed roof
designators.description: Set a roof or terrain within the specified range.

designators.label: bridge
designators.description: Set a roof or terrain within the specified range.

designators.label: Spawn: Wood
designators.description:
Wood from trees or other fibrous plants. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel. In a pinch, a piece of wood can be used as a weapon or a leg.
Tip: Right click to open the menu and select the thing to generate.

designators.label: move out
designators.description: Mark items that need to be moved out from the sub map, pay attention! Only when the target map is a sub map of a certain map can it be used.

designators.label: Move in submap（No Submap）
designators.description: Mark items that need to be moved into the sub map, pay attention! It can only be used when there is a target sub map.

designators.label: <color=#75BBFDFF>Pawn spawner</color>
designators.description:
Used to generate pawns.
Tip: Right click to select a custom thing.

designators.label: <color=#75BBFDFF>Trap editor</color>
designators.description: <color=#75BBFDFF>Used to edit traps.</color>

designators.label: Set faction: Null
designators.description: Set the faction for selected things.

designators.label: Set style:Null
designators.description: Set the style for selected things.

designators.label: Set hit points: 100%
designators.description: Set the hit points of selected things. Right click to switch modes.

designators.label: Set quality: Normal
designators.description: Set the quality of selected things. Right click to switch between fixed, upgrade, and downgrade modes.

designators.label: Blueprint
designators.description: Place custom map blueprints. Right click to open the floating blueprint palette.

designators.label: Batch pasting(Loot box)
designators.description: Paste the copied data into a selected thing.

designators.label: Save Zone: Circular
designators.description: Select a circular zone to save as a custom map def.(Only applicable to saving map part. If saving a whole map, please use Save Whole Map)

designators.label: Disgenerate
designators.description: Mark the area, and the zone core will not generate the "map part" in the disgenerate area.

designators.label: Disdestroy
designators.description: Mark the area, and when generating custom map data, the thing within the area will not be destroyed.

designators.label: Custom lord
designators.description: Customize lord within the map, lord data will be saved in the custom map def

designators.label: Destroy Item
designators.description: Order a pawn to destroy this item

designators.label: Destroy item
designators.description: Burns chosen item at closest campfire, destroying it completely. Requires campfire or smelter to work.

designators.label: Recycle item
designators.description: Recycle chosen item to get valuables resources out of it. If item can be smelted it will require smelter to get recycled, otherwise it will be scrapped on it's location.

designators.label: Destroy item
designators.description: Burns chosen item at closest campfire, destroying it completely. Requires campfire or smelter to work.

designators.label: Recycle item
designators.description: Recycle chosen item to get valuables resources out of it. If item can be smelted it will require smelter to get recycled, otherwise it will be scrapped on it's location.

designators.label: Rearm Traps
designators.description: Designate traps to be rearmed by colonists.

designators.label: Open
designators.description: Open containers.

designators.label: Paint Tool
designators.description: Paint buildings, apparel and terrain
